column1: #   source = https://...   downloaded and verified against this lock
#   source = build:<script> produced by rish's own hash-verified builder
#            (path relative to the rish checkout). size 0 / all-zero sha256
#            marks a built artifact that rish's build verifies instead.
# Kernel: vmlinuz-virt from the Alpine 3.24.1 netboot release, renamed for
# the slot path referenced in manifest.plist (kernel/vmlinuz-virt-6.18.35).
# Initramfs: rish's interactive container initramfs (busybox + guest agent).
# rish pins every input in guest/x86_64/assets.lock.tsv (and derived.lock);
# building here needs squashfs-tools and the x86_64-unknown-linux-musl rust
# target. Set RISH_INITRD_URL/RISH_INITRD_SHA256 to use a prebuilt release
